Inspected public UI JavaScript displays server signatures but does not document its server wallet-signing prefix or implement a verifier. Bounded search for NonKYC/verifymessage/signatures did not identify an official alternate convention.
conclusion: The alternate source constants justify bounded compatibility checks but do not establish which convention NonKYC used. Keep exchange-published, signatures not verified by native node unless an independent exact-key recovery succeeds. A failure does not by itself establish forgery.
